summary: Iteration 14 (legal pages + localized notifications + translated rides/profile/driver/company tabs) fully verified. Backend 4/4 pytest tests pass: GET /api/legal fr/en/zh(fallback) returns terms/privacy/cancellation each with title + >=5 sections, {company}/{email} placeholders replaced by 'RideGo' and support email; localized notifications work — ES title 'Chófer encontrado' + driver name + 'está en camino' on accept, 'Viaje iniciado' on start, 'Viaje finalizado' on complete; switching back to FR keeps inline 'Chauffeur trouvé'. Frontend: passenger 'My rides' title, English status badge (Completed), 'Book again' button, ride detail 'Ride completed', profile title 'Profile' all correct in EN; legal sheet opens with tabs terms/privacy/cancellation showing 'Terms of Service' and 'Cancellation Policy' pages and close (X) works. Driver tabs read Home / Private / Team / Documents / Earnings / Profile with 'Driver profile' title. Company tabs read Dashboard / Employees / Company. No boot console errors observed. Booking sheet on passenger home still renders (English service labels visible: Private Driver, Airport Transfer, ...).
